title: Real-time or behaviour monitoring is not enforced

report.title: {Items.Count} antivirus {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy does', 'policies do')} not enforce real-time protection

messages.businessImpact: Malware is detected only during a scheduled scan, by which time it has run. Real-time protection is the difference between prevention and forensics.
remediation: Enable real-time protection and behaviour monitoring in each policy listed.
messages.cannotSee: What the object asks for is read, not what Defender is doing on a device. A device where another product has taken over real-time scanning, or where somebody with local rights turned it off, is not visible here, and neither is a device the policy has not reached yet. A Defender setting is read wherever it sits, whether that is an endpoint security policy, a security baseline or a Settings Catalog profile, and the report names which. An object that says nothing about a setting is not reported for it, because saying nothing and switching it off are different things and only the second is a finding.
